Saúde mental ao longo da vida | Linhas d: Mental health across the life course | GPIS research areas
Mental health is rarely a fixed state. It can change over time, forming different trajectories of symptoms and well-being. Our work in this area is to describe these trajectories in real populations and to investigate the social, family and individual contexts associated with them.
Trabalhamos sobretudo com dados longitud: We work mainly with longitudinal data — following the same people over time — because this helps distinguish one-off changes from persistent patterns. The 2019 Rio Grande Birth Cohort is one of the group's main platforms for this kind of research.
Queremos também identificar momentos e c: We also want to identify moments and contexts in which prevention, care and support may be especially relevant.

Álcool e saúde mental durante a pandemia: Alcohol and mental health during the pandemic
5% das mães relataram aumento do consumo: 5% of mothers reported drinking more alcohol during the pandemic; in this group, depression and anxiety scores were higher.
Isso não mostra que o álcool tenha causa: This does not show that alcohol caused these symptoms, but it indicates that changes in drinking can accompany periods of greater psychological distress.
Durante o isolamento, 51,9% das mães rel: During isolation, 51.9% of mothers reported less physical activity and 58.1% said they had increased the amount of food they ate.
Crises de saúde pública também transform: Public health crises also transform eating routines, physical activity and other habits that are part of everyday health.
Parte do sofrimento das mães durante a p: Part of mothers' distress during the pandemic was linked precisely to concern for their children's safety and future.
Sono na gestação e sintomas de depressão: Sleep in pregnancy and symptoms of depression and anxiety
Menor duração do sono, dificuldade para: Shorter sleep, difficulty falling asleep or getting up and a more evening-type sleep pattern were associated with more symptoms of depression and/or anxiety.
Observar o sono pode ajudar a reconhecer: Looking at sleep can help recognise situations of greater emotional vulnerability in the perinatal period.
Ter dados anteriores à crise permitiu di: Having data from before the crisis made it possible to size the change in maternal mental health, instead of observing only an isolated snapshot of that moment.
Depressão e ansiedade ao longo da pandem: Depression and anxiety throughout the pandemic
Entre as mães avaliadas nos três momento: Among mothers assessed at all three time points, depression rose from 3.1% before the pandemic to 30.6% at the second assessment during the pandemic; anxiety rose from 9.6% to 28.8%.
Seguir as mesmas mulheres ao longo do te: Following the same women over time showed the scale of the change and illustrates the strength of a cohort for studying what happens during a crisis.
Como a distribuição do cuidado, do traba: How the distribution of care, housework and power within relationships connects to mothers' health and well-being.
Saúde mental também se relaciona à forma: Mental health is also related to how housework and care are divided at home.
Carga doméstica desigual e violência por: Unequal housework and intimate partner violence
Quando a carga de trabalho doméstico rec: When the burden of housework fell more unequally on mothers, the odds of psychological, physical or sexual intimate partner violence were also higher.
Os resultados mostram que desigualdade d: The findings show that domestic inequality and violence can coexist within broader contexts of gender inequality.
O que aprendemos sobre desenvolvimento i: What we have learned about child development, prevention and new ways of supporting mothers and children.
Saúde mental materna e desenvolvimento d: Maternal mental health and child development
Crianças de mães com trajetórias mais el: Children of mothers with higher trajectories of depressive symptoms showed more delays in language, cognition and motor development at 24 months. Anxiety trajectories were also associated with delays in some domains.
Saúde mental materna e desenvolvimento i: Maternal mental health and child development appear as connected trajectories, without this meaning that one alone determines the other.
O que as mães sabiam sobre prevenção da: What mothers knew about preventing sudden infant death
67,7% das mães não conheciam a posição r: 67.7% of mothers did not know the recommended position to reduce the risk of sudden infant death, and only 1.9% said they had received information on the topic during prenatal care.
O resultado aponta uma oportunidade conc: The finding points to a concrete opportunity to reinforce safe-sleep guidance during prenatal care and after birth.
Apoio às mães pelo WhatsApp: o estudo TI: Supporting mothers through WhatsApp: the TIES study
Um grupo de apoio moderado pelo WhatsApp: A WhatsApp-moderated support group proved feasible and was well accepted by participants, although engagement declined over the weeks.
Ferramentas digitais podem ampliar as po: Digital tools can broaden the options for supporting mothers, but keeping people engaged over time remains a challenge. As a feasibility study, this work does not test the intervention's effectiveness.
